# YAML

Full rules, evidence and examples: `common/languages/yaml.md`.

- YAML-01 must: Start every YAML file with `---`; add a `# yaml-language-server: $schema=<url>` line next to it for Flux, Kustomize and Helm resources and chart values. [tool:yamllint]
  Good: `---` then `# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://example.com/kustomization.json` then `resources:`.
  Bad: a Kustomization file that starts directly with `resources:`.
- YAML-02 prefer: Quote strings YAML would misread (`"true"`, `"5432"`, `"01:00"`, `"${VAR}"`); leave other strings bare.
- YAML-03 must: Use two-space indentation, sequences indented under their key, a blank line between logical blocks in values files, a final newline and no trailing spaces. [tool:yamllint]
  Good: `items:` followed by `- name: a` indented two spaces under the key, one blank line between blocks.
  Bad: `items:` with `- name: a` flush left, four-space indents, trailing spaces.
- YAML-04 prefer: Run `yamllint .` in every repo with `extends: default` in a file named `.yamllint.yml`, using the long rule family (`line-length` off) in new repos. Observed: set `empty-lines.max: 2` and braces and brackets `max-spaces-inside: 1`. [tool:yamllint]
